items.title: Carnet de voyage : un an de reinforcement learning en production
items.markdown: A field diary of one year running a reinforcement learning project for real-time bidding: building a market simulator from scratch, sculpting a reward function that encodes a business strategy, and an A/B test that invalidated a core latency assumption within hours. Ends on the reward-shaping inversion that turned out to be a theorem, now under review at TMLR. In French.

items.title: 4 self-hosting failures that return success
items.markdown: Four ways a self-hosted server reports success while being broken: a `200` on a gated WebDAV endpoint, a healthcheck with no `curl` in the image, a backup that exits 0 with an empty archive, and a Wake-on-LAN packet that quietly evaporates. Companion repo: [sober-selfhost](https://github.com/mbaelde/sober-selfhost).
